scope: Preserve canonical ACAD APPID flags while retaining atomic refusal for unsupported non-flag metadata.
regression: The initial flag-refusal guard at 507ae368 caused Linux and Windows FreeCAD release qualification and fast/native jobs to fail on generated DWG handoffs. The AC1021 source inspection found ACAD flags=64, with empty application/XDATA/reactor metadata.
change: Backpatch the fixed-width canonical APPID group 70 after the callback, using a scoped per-thread sink and the existing bounded group-70 writer. Conflicting duplicate values refuse. Non-flag metadata that the prewritten row cannot retain still refuses. No public data member or virtual function was added.

Nested distinct writers retain independent flags; conflicting callbacks preserve the destination and a corrected same-writer retry passes.

Generated AC1021, AC1024 and AC1032 DWG -> ASCII/Binary DXF conversions pass 6/6 with ACAD flag 64 on readback.
The FreeCAD CLI compatibility check passes and now verifies flag 64 after conversion and DXF retry.

The focused CLI contract passed when run directly; its 25-second CTest wrapper timed out locally both inside and outside the sandbox.
The APPID allocation, LTYPE allocation and source-table identity CTests passed 3/3.

The frozen implementation digest was refreshed from a clean temporary index matching all 5988 staged tracked entries; digest validation and its self-test pass. Claim statuses and receipt references are unchanged.
limitations: The failed hosted revision is not qualified; the corrected revision must rerun fast, native and FreeCAD hosted jobs.
